name: list
summary: List Watchtower lanes relevant to the resolved repository without changing lane state.

flags.name: workspace
flags.description: Resolve lanes from this existing repository or control-home path.

flags.name: lane
flags.description: Limit the result to one relevant lane ID or slug.

flags.name: initiative
flags.description: Limit results to one initiative ID.

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Return 1 to 200 records per page; defaults to 50.

flags.name: cursor
flags.description: Continue a stable projection from an opaque cursor.

flags.name: no-color
flags.description: Disable ANSI color in human output.

flags.name: verbose
flags.description: Include bounded resolution, lane-count, page-count, warning, and conflict diagnostics.
